name: fifa17-fake-server
description: Local/fake EA backend emulator for FIFA 17 Ultimate Team (PC)

scripts.start:baseline: set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_CIDS="&& set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_ASRC="&& set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_RSRC="&& set "PING_SWALLOW=1"&& tsx src/index.ts
scripts.start:auth-test: set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_ASRC="&& set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_RSRC="&& set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_CIDS=1,9"&& set "PING_SWALLOW=1"&& tsx src/index.ts
scripts.start:asrc-test: set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_CIDS="&& set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_RSRC="&& set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_ASRC=FIFA17DEFAULTID"&& set "PING_SWALLOW=1"&& tsx src/index.ts
scripts.start:auth-combo-test: set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_RSRC="&& set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_ASRC=FIFA17DEFAULTID"&& set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_CIDS=1,9"&& set "PING_SWALLOW=1"&& tsx src/index.ts
scripts.start:rsrc-test: set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_ASRC="&& set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_CIDS="&& set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_RSRC=FIFA17DEFAULTID"&& set "PING_SWALLOW=1"&& tsx src/index.ts
scripts.start:ping-codec-test: set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_CIDS="&& set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_ASRC="&& set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_RSRC="&& set "PING_SWALLOW=0"&& tsx src/index.ts
scripts.start:auth-noreply-test: set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_CIDS="&& set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_ASRC="&& set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_RSRC="&& set "PING_SWALLOW=0"&& set "AUTH_REPLY_PROFILE=none"&& set "AUTH_NOTIFY=0"&& tsx src/index.ts
scripts.start:auth-origin-layer: set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_CIDS="&& set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_ASRC="&& set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_RSRC="&& set "PING_SWALLOW=0"&& set "AUTH_REPLY_PROFILE=plst"&& set "AUTH_NOTIFY=0"&& tsx src/index.ts
scripts.start:auth-origin-notify: set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_CIDS="&& set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_ASRC="&& set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_RSRC="&& set "PING_SWALLOW=0"&& set "AUTH_REPLY_PROFILE=plst"&& set "AUTH_NOTIFY=1"&& tsx src/index.ts
scripts.start:auth-origin-notify-delay: set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_CIDS="&& set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_ASRC="&& set "BLAZE_PREAUTH_RSRC="&& set "PING_SWALLOW=0"&& set "AUTH_REPLY_PROFILE=plst"&& set "AUTH_NOTIFY=1"&& set "AUTH_NOTIFY_DELAY_MS=750"&& tsx src/index.ts
scripts.test:lsx-crypto: tsx -e "import { assertLsxCryptoVectors } from './src/lsx/crypto.ts'; assertLsxCryptoVectors(); console.log('LSX crypto OK');"
scripts.db:up: prisma dev start fifa17 || prisma dev --name fifa17 --detach
